message: Hi Alex, it's Luis at Summit Heating, nice. Can you also build me a mobile app for bookings and run my Facebook ads while you are at it? Same price?
reply: Hi Luis, good to hear from you! We're web-only though — no apps or ad management, so I can't take those on. The $900 fix pack covers your website issues, and the $250/mo care plan keeps it maintained after. For the app and Facebook ads, you'd want a specialist in those areas. Want me to send the site audit first?
